quizzes.question: In which year did Nigeria gain independence from British rule?
Who was the first Prime Minister of independent Nigeria?
options: Sir Abubakar Tafawa Balewa
Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe
Chief Obafemi Awolowo
Sir Ahmadu Bello

quizzes.question: On which date is Nigeria's Independence Day celebrated every year?
options: October 1st
October 5th
October 12th
October 24th

quizzes.question: When an entity in severe financial difficulty prepares its financial statements on a break-up basis rather than a going concern basis, how are its non-current assets classified and measured on the Statement of Financial Position?
options: Classified as current assets and valued at recoverable amount on sale
Classified as non-current assets and valued at historical cost less depreciation
Classified as current assets and valued at historical cost less impairment
Classified as non-current assets and valued at fair value less cost to sell
quizzes.correct_answer: Classified as current assets and valued at recoverable amount on sale

quizzes.question: A company sells goods to a third party for N10,000 with an agreement to repurchase them in 12 months for N11,000. Applying the principle of substance over legal form, how should the seller record this transaction at inception?
options: Retain goods in inventory and recognize a liability for N10,000
Record a sale of N10,000 and recognize the immediate profit in profit or loss
Record a purchase of N11,000 and a trade payable of N11,000
Derecognize the inventory and record a trade receivable of N1,000
quizzes.correct_answer: Retain goods in inventory and recognize a liability for N10,000

quizzes.question: According to Chapter 2 of the IASB Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, which of the following are categorized as the fundamental qualitative characteristics of useful financial information?
options: Relevance and Faithful Representation
Comparability, Verifiability, Timeliness, and Understandability
Understandability, Relevance, Reliability, and Comparability
Faithful Representation, Neutrality, Prudence, and Completeness

quizzes.question: Under Section 143(4) of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria (as amended), what majority is required in each House of the National Assembly to pass a motion that allegations of gross misconduct against the President be investigated?
options: Simple majority of members present and voting
Not less than two-thirds majority of all members of each House
Absolute majority of all members of the National Assembly sitting jointly
Three-quarters majority of the Senate only
quizzes.correct_answer: Not less than two-thirds majority of all members of each House

quizzes.question: Which of the following matters is contained in the Concurrent Legislative List rather than the Exclusive Legislative List under the Second Schedule of the 1999 Constitution of Nigeria?
options: Currency, coinage and legal tender
Allocation of wave-lengths for wireless broadcasting
Industrial, commercial or agricultural development
Citizenship, naturalisation and aliens

quizzes.question: According to Section 179(1) of the 1999 Constitution, what requirement must a sole nominated candidate for Governor satisfy to be declared duly elected?
options: He is automatically declared elected by the electoral commission without any voting process
He must win a simple majority of YES votes over NO votes and at least one-quarter of votes cast in each of at least two-thirds of all local government areas in the State
He must secure at least 50 percent of total registered voters in the State in a referendum
He must receive approval from two-thirds of members of the State House of Assembly
quizzes.correct_answer: He must win a simple majority of YES votes over NO votes and at least one-quarter of votes cast in each of at least two-thirds of all local government areas in the State
